termination.exact_next_action: Continue read-only SPLiT S1 Code.zip recovery without mutation. Replace fixed cause-labelled duration tables with an online state-identity-anchored duration learner: maintain separate duration experts only when emission/prediction prototypes supply enough cause identity, shrink each duration model toward a geometric base when identity confidence is low, and explicitly test label-permutation symmetry before trusting duration semantics. Compare against fixed HSMM, duration-blind HMM, capped/shrunk HSMM, and supervised oracle adaptation on held-out gradual duration drift, abrupt duration swap, class-prior shift, emission-prototype drift, and mixed nonstationarity. Feed posterior confidence into tracker-specific dormant-memory controllers with separately calibrated plasticity/time constants instead of a universal threshold; measure post-silence recovery, post-switch interference, Brier/ECE, duration-trust adaptation latency, false/true memory admission, and O(Nk) state cost.
